text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Satsuki Sho over, as we were 
preparing for our next goal, the Japanese 
Derby—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding the new routine we discussed 
after the Satsuki Sho... I'd like to 
propose increasing our mock races."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that her lack of experience 
might be one of the reasons she gets so 
overly invested in races."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
So, we'll expose you to environments close 
to the real thing to sharpen your mental 
control.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I understand that as well. The closer we 
get to actual race conditions, the higher 
the risk of injury and physical wear and 
tear.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However... this is the Derby. ...I want to 
win it flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her determination is unwavering. However, 
what she needs right now... isn't to run 
more races, but to broaden her 
perspective. Getting too fixated will only 
narrow her vision.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, my voice got through to her 
during the Satsuki Sho. I just have to 
expand on that feeling—
choice_data_list:
(For example, something that 'connects' 
with the world...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
""Connecting"—that keyword suddenly caught 
my attention."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I feel like there 
was an Umamusume talking about that. Yes, 
that was after a certain Nippon Derby 
race..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“――I made the 'connection.' On the 
'trajectory' of victory, 'I' was there...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe. A Classic Double Crown 
winner whose effortless victory at the 
Japanese Derby is still vivid in memory—a 
truly mysterious horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's her, she might be able to give 
Duramente the spark she needs to broaden 
her horizons even further.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Singularity." You were... never supposed 
to appear.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"That's how it is 'over here.' Still... I 
see. Things really do change."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Neo Universe has... had an 
"epiphany"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Claaang...!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Good work," Duramente. Time for a break.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Universe. To have someone of your 
caliber impart wisdom to me is deeply 
appreciated."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Still... why "meditation"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: In order to "connect."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Duramente and Neo Universe are 
"piggybacking"... A little bit "SITL."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I know. 'TRGDY'... 'You' 'too' 
are in danger."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To evade it, I must 'connect.' To a higher 
dimension... deeper into the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Duramente's expression didn't change, 
but a question mark practically popped 
over her head. In short, I want her to 
look at things from a broader perspective—
choice_data_list:
It's special training to broaden your 
horizons.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If you say so... I'll give it a 
try.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Universe. —I'm in your care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, between training sessions, 
Duramente was to undergo training to 
"connect" with Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Waterfall meditation"... In harsh 
conditions, I focus purely on "thinking".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Duramente. What matters is feeling 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Pain and cold are both merely "data to 
analyze." Feel everything, and think 
ceaselessly...
choice_data_list:
I'll make sure to prepare something warm 
for you!

I'll make sure to prepare something warm 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —...Ugh, so cold...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Now, feel it... 
..................—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Amazing. It's already been a whole 
hour...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —It means "to connect."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The world simply exists. ...It's merely 
'connecting,' Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, while progressing through 
preparations for the Japanese Derby like 
that, Duramente's conditioning had reached 
its peak."
choice_data_list: Yeah, your time is perfect too!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see. ...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is for the meditation to 
take effect... ...There aren't many days 
left until the Derby.
choice_data_list: Try relaxing your shoulders a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Set aside family duties, the Japan Derby, 
the future... Strip it all away and just 
feel the world. You don't need to think 
about achieving anything.
choice_data_list: What is the world like where you are?
What is the world you live in like?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...The world where I exist.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —*pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I can see clearly.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(The world I'm in, huh... There's a 
breeze. There are... so many people. The 
sky is so high.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is that not it? This is tricky...—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah. Arcturus...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "α Boo". That's α Boötis... right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...Good evening. Are you stargazing?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I was guided here... for the sake of 
"communion."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...? I see.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Arcturus is in a hurry. And yet, Arcturus 
is in no hurry at all.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
From one perspective, it appears so. From 
the perspective of Arcturus, it is not.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me, what are you talking 
about?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Duramente. Is Arcturus 'all alone'?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe... does not know. Because 
who she calls out to is not 'them.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
One can only "observe" Neo Universe as 
seen from Arcturus.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is something like that actually possible?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Duramente. 'Where' will "you" "take off" 
to?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Duramente from the perspective of 
Arcturus. Arcturus from the perspective of 
Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"We'll 'connect'...... If you 'observe' 
me—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Will Arcturus... no longer be "all alone"?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(See through the eyes of Arcturus... Relax 
the shoulders. And "take off" into the 
heavens...—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...—I hear the cry of a bird. It took off 
in the distance... spreading its wings, 
soaring gracefully.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Laughter of children from over there... A 
footrace? Ah... someone won. Everyone's 
cheering for them.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Where else? From where shall I look upon 
the world I inhabit—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Now...—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Con anima."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—It means "to connect." "Hello"... 
Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Duramente's report... I arranged 
a mock race with Neo Universe to test the 
sensation she claimed to have found.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(—I can feel it. Universe's positioning... 
Her breathing... The movement of her 
gaze... Even what she's thinking.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(The wind, the turf, the track condition. 
And myself—I understand everything... My 
heartbeat, down to the movement of every 
single muscle fiber—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I can see how to win! ...Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I am no longer needed"... With that 
smile, Neo Universe walked away. —The 
training was over.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...How strange. It feels as though... my 
eyes have finally opened.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Things I couldn't see before... things I 
couldn't hear before... they all came 
flooding in.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—It feels as though I'm connected to the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, I'm starting to understand. I 
was surely just afraid.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Because I was completely blind to 
everything else. If I ease up on my pace 
even a little, I'll be overtaken... Fear 
had narrowed my vision.
choice_data_list:
That's why she insisted on running away 
from the competition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you connect with the world and look at 
the race from a bird's-eye view, the fear 
fades. You can adapt and deliver the most 
optimal—the absolute strongest run.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yet... I'm not scared anymore.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby... My dream. That 
grand stage I yearn for..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The path to victory—I know I'll find it.
